note: A model reading of kind found, checked against its note by a fixed rule (shared/engine-ts/src/found.ts, correctFoundKind). The reading becomes a clue only when every "found" in the note is followed by a determiner (a, an, some, the, his, their, or a possessive her) and a known object, every word of the note is one the rule knows an object-found note may hold, and no word could name the person (a person, family, state or response word, or one of the profile's names). Any other reading is returned unchanged, including a note with a single unknown word. The corrected reading's item and feature come from the note, and the reason is shown. parserKind is what the phones' rules parser (ReportParser.kind) gives the same note, so a platform can check its parser agrees.
